rationale: S-0052-04 proposes a t0052 (scalar gabaMOD) vs t0053 (spatial PD/ND-asymmetric inhibition) cross-comparison. t0057 demonstrated the spatial substrate has a degenerate FULL tuning curve at every swept conductance; the cross-comparison is less informative until the spatial substrate has a working operating point with non-zero peak Hz. t0059 may produce that operating point on the bar-locked variant; the comparison can be revisited then. Reprioritising from high to medium.
